description: Create a use case of a Foundry ontology: an agent's task (such as answering support tickets) whose runs record what the agent read and wrote between its request and its answer. Start a run with helix_foundry_start_use_case_run each time the agent works on a request.

client_token.description: At most 64 characters; the same token returns the use case it made instead of making another.

description.description: What the agent does, at most 2,000 characters.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters naming what the agent does, such as Support triage.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_create_use_case

origin.description: person (an owner or admin made it), or workflow: Foundry made it to record the runs of a workflow (its workflow field) that use this ontology, and only Foundry starts and finishes its runs.

workflow.description: The workflow whose runs it records, for a use case of origin workflow.

title: Create a Foundry use case
